leader.name: Eustass"Captain"Kid
leader.text: [End of Your Turn] You may turn 1 card from the top of your Life cards face-up: Set up to 1 of your {Supernovas} type Characters with a cost of 3 to 8 as active. That Character gains [Blocker] until the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Cavendish
cards.text: [On K.O.] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.

cards.name: Killer
cards.text:
[Your Turn] [On Play] If your Leader has the {Kid Pirates} type, add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.

[Trigger] If your opponent has 3 or less Life cards, play this card.

cards.name: Scratchmen Apoo
cards.text: [Trigger] Draw 1 card and your {Supernovas} type Leader's base power becomes 7000 during this turn.

cards.name: Bartolomeo
cards.text: [On Play] You may trash 1 {Supernovas} type card from your hand: Draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Eustass"Captain"Kid
cards.text:
[On Your Opponent's Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may turn 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards face-down: Change the target of the attack to your [Eustass"Captain"Kid] with 5000 base power or more.

[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may turn 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards face-up: Give up to 1 rested DON!! card to your Leader.

cards.name: Capone"Gang"Bege
cards.text:
[On Play] You may add 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards to your hand: Add up to 1 {Supernovas} type Character card from your hand to the top of your Life cards face-up.

Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.

cards.name: Basil Hawkins
cards.text:
[On K.O.] Trash up to 1 card from the top of your opponent's Life cards.

[Trigger] Draw 2 cards and trash 1 card from your hand.

Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.

cards.name: Monkey.D.Luffy
cards.text:
[On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Supernovas} type card other than [Monkey.D.Luffy] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.

cards.name: X.Drake
cards.text: [Activate: Main] You may rest this Character: If the number of your Life cards is equal to or less than the number of your opponent's Life cards, rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.

cards.name: Roronoa Zoro (113)
cards.text:
[On K.O.] If your Leader has the "Supernovas" type, play up to 1 "Supernovas" type Character card with a cost of 4 or less from your hand rested.
[Trigger] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 1 or less and add this card to your hand.

cards.name: Jewelry Bonney
cards.text:
[On Play] If your Leader has the {Supernovas} type and the number of your Life cards is equal to or less than the number of your opponent's Life cards, add up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less to the top or bottom of the owner's Life cards face-up.

Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.

cards.name: Trafalgar Law
cards.text:
[Trigger] If your Leader has the {Supernovas} type and you and your opponent have a total of 5 or less Life cards, play this card.

Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.

cards.name: The One Who Is the Most Free Is the Pirate King!!!
cards.text:
[Main] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 "Supernovas" type Character card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Trigger] Activate this card's [Main] effect.
